body:
Adds two sections to `prompt.md`:

- **Research integrity**: attribution, quoting, citation checks, neutral reporting of discrepancies, no overclaiming, AI-assistance disclosure, no contacting cited faculty. Invariant across all prompt versions.
- **Prompt experiments (~5% of effort)**: route ~20% of runs to a candidate `prompts/prompt-<n>.md` via `prompts/routing.json`, tag commits with `Prompt-Version`, log each run to `prompts/runs.jsonl` (prompt inputs, model, time, tokens, diff size, CI/review outcomes, errors, integrity issues), backfill history from `Claude-Session` / `Co-Authored-By` trailers and transcripts, and review every ~20 runs to promote or retire candidates.

`python site/build.py` prints `ok`.
